verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rule or automation feature that triggers actions on events. What it does show are developer building blocks: Gateway WebSocket events and HTTP event notifications that a developer could use to build a bot implementing such rules. Building blocks earn no credit toward the story's own capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild, like when a channel is updated or a role is created.
Send messages into Discord channels or receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP.
